data.name: Task Force: Thunderstorm
data.detailed_description:
【Game Introduction】

Thunderstorm Task Force is a fast-paced, hardcore FPS game that delivers a pure and exhilarating shooting experience. The game offers a variety of core gameplay modes to cater to different preferences, ensuring that whether you're a PVP pro or a PVE co-op enthusiast, you can find your own battlefield.

【Game Content】

Rich Armory

The game features a diverse array of distinctive firearms, encompassing various classic weapon types.

Each weapon has been meticulously tuned, boasting unique recoil patterns, rates of fire, reload speeds, and shooting feel. You can find the perfect weapon for you through practice, or switch weapons between different modes to adapt to ever-changing battlefield situations.

Attachment System

What truly makes each gun unique is the weapon modification system. You can freely replace various weapon parts to create your own personalized weapon of mass destruction.

A variety of attachment combinations ensure that each weapon is truly unique. You can equip a highly stable assault rifle for multiplayer battles, a fast-paced submachine gun for solo battles, and a light machine gun with a large-capacity magazine for zombie mode—adjust freely according to the mode and tactics to find the most comfortable combat configuration!

Thunderstorm Task Force pursues pure shooting thrills with a fast-paced gameplay. Each match averages 4-9 minutes, with immediate combat and no long waits. Respawn points are close to the battlefield, allowing you to return to the fight within seconds of death, keeping you constantly immersed in intense combat.

【Fair Competition】

Thunderstorm Task Force adheres to the principle of fair competition, without any pay-to-win stat systems that affect balance. All weapons and attachments can be unlocked through in-game progress.

  • No Attribute Bonuses: Paid content is limited to cosmetic skins and does not affect combat attributes.

  • Fair Unlocking: Weapons and attachments are unlocked through levels or challenges and cannot be directly purchased.

  • Skill First: Victory depends solely on your marksmanship, awareness, reaction time, and teamwork.

True skill-based competition, rejecting pay-to-win dominance. Here, high-ranking players possess matching skill, not just "money power."

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Redeon RX550 / Nvidia GTX 750ti 4G
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Storage: 15 GB available space
